messages:
Sarah: FYI HelioMed (acct HM-107) flagged INV-2026-3299 for $62,150. They emailed asking to put account on hold and asked for a 60-day net due date because their internal PO didn’t match. Posting thread.

Noah: Do we have the PO on file? They referenced PO-HM-21 but AR shows PO-HM-19. Looks like mismatch on line items.

Emily: Support uploaded the vendor remittance and says Helio provided a credit memo CM-77 for $4,500 that we haven't applied. Ticket #4412 opened for reconciliation.

Vendor-Helio: (vendor) We sent PO-HM-21 before shipment, billing address updated same day. Please confirm receipt of CM-77 or we need to escalate to procurement.

Sarah: Proposed path: apply CM-77 if validated (~$4.5k), offer either net-60 or 3-installment plan (40/30/30) with signed plan + ACH mandate. No suspension while plan active. Thoughts? :thinking_face: 

Finance-manager: Ok to offer net-60 if they sign waiver for timely payment and confirm PO-HM-21 in writing. If they request installments, include $200 processing fee.

Collections-bot: Scheduled dunning: reminder email will be sent at 1840002000 if no signed agreement or payment is received.

Audits-bot: Reconciliation started: audit will confirm CM-77 application within 2 business days. If CM valid, adjust AR and send updated invoice.

Noah: I can validate the credit memo. If it's valid, new balance ~57,650. I'll update ledger code HM-107-REV after audit.

Sarah: Sent DocuSign with two options to billing@heliomed.com: (A) Net60 with PO confirmation, (B) 3-pay plan 40/30/30 + $200 fee. Also attached CM-77 and ticket link.

Vendor-Helio: Received DocuSign. Procurement confirms PO-HM-21 now (attached). They prefer net-60. We'll sign and submit ACH mandate within 3 business days.

Emily: Marking ticket #4412 pending. If signed net-60 arrives, pause escalation. If not, escalate to finance-manager per bot schedule.

Finance-manager: Thanks. If ACH fails or they miss the signature deadline, we proceed with service suspension notice and escalate. Keep me posted.
